list: Forbes Middle East Top 100 Arab Family Businesses
origin: contested: headquartered in Beirut since 1965; founded in Damascus

origin_check.says: Established in Beirut in 1897 by Khalil Fares Fattal; country Lebanon (Forbes Middle East 2024 entry).

Trading company created in Damascus in 1897; the family was Syrian (from Aleppo, settled in Damascus); a Beirut branch opened in the early 1920s and all operations moved to Beirut in 1965 after the Damascus offices were nationalised.

note: Two sources disagree on the place of founding. Headquartered in Lebanon, so it meets the HQ rule; it does not clearly meet 'Lebanese origin'. CMA CGM announced a plan to acquire 100 percent; closing expected in Q3 2026, value not disclosed (https://trans.info/en/cma-cgm-fattal-group-469040). Not in the 2021 to 2023 or 2026 top-100 lists read.
